run_ResNet_training: run a ResNet model training loop with SGD optimizer and configurable learning rate decay
run_training_with_resume: run training from a checkpoint file to resume an interrupted ResNet training session
run_accuracy_evaluation: run top-1 and top-5 accuracy evaluation on validation scores and labels tensors
run_learning_rate_schedule: run a step-based learning rate schedule with warmup epochs for an SGD optimizer
run_model_selection: run a ResNet model (10, 18, 34, 50, or 101) with a specified number of classes
